chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Harun ibn Muslim, from Mas'ada ibn Ziyad, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The fruits are of one hundred and twenty types, the chief of these being the Pomegranate.
ai.seo_question: What is the status of the pomegranate among fruits according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) identifies the pomegranate as the 'master' of the 120 varieties of fruits, a designation that underscores its unique spiritual and physical virtues in Shia tradition. This classification is often interpreted by scholars as reflecting the fruit's symbolic purity and its frequent mention in the Quran as a sign of Paradise, thereby elevating its status beyond mere culinary preference to a marker of divine blessing.
